note: The driver the title links, frozen out of ../PS5_Vulkan into build/frozen-driver/ before this build and verified unchanged after it: the archives are copied to a stable tree and PS5_VULKAN_DIR/PS5_VULKAN_ICD point at it, because that project is developed concurrently and a rebuilt archive under the title's link is a different driver. ps5_vulkan_subject: Migrate the driver to ps5-opengl 0.3.0's compiler fork, and close the console SIGFPE at its owner
ps5_vulkan_state: The format audit is unchanged by the migration (179 formats required, 58 reported, 0 missing a required feature, 55 conditional, split 0/0/0/0/0), and driver/ps5vk_image.c is not touched by this commit: VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM still carries SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT with the 8_8_8_8_UNORM descriptor word and the ZYXW selectors, which is the fetch order the frontend's own XRGB8888 bytes rely on. What the commit does change is the shader compiler (ps5-opengl 0.3.0's opengnm-psbc tree, metadata v14), the compute dispatch words, a null shader module in ps5vk_compile_stage that faulted every meta clear/blit/resolve, and a driver-owned 32 MiB compile stack.
archives_are_current_for_the_tree: no driver/*.c, driver/*.h, tooling/*.py or tools/*.sh file is newer than the archives, and the driver's working tree is clean at this revision
frozen_at: build/frozen-driver (git-ignored; the two commands that build it are in docs/PHASE_LOG.md)
identity_covers_these_archives: tools/build-title.sh's printed identity f9e4ea6c9d6261cda7854fed71c854e0f138aa8733f54869733d3727919f54fe was recomputed from that script's own input list - src/, the frontend archive, config.h, the six core objects, the four driver archives and the three Mesa utility objects - against these exact frozen archive hashes, and matched. The identity string is compiled into the title, so the shipped eboot names the driver it carries.
